scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @sunny/api" "npm run dev -w @sunny/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sunny/shared && npm run build -w @sunny/api && npm run build -w @sunny/web
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types packages/shared/src/index.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types apps/web/src/admin/admin-css.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types apps/web/src/admin/editor/markdown.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types apps/api/src/auth.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types apps/api/src/services/posts.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types apps/api/src/services/media.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types apps/api/src/services/settings.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sunny/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sunny/api && npm run typecheck -w @sunny/web
